smell_validity.evidence: The pre-injection formatter.go was already a legitimate dispatch hub, so the smell is precisely absorption, not coordination: Renderer owns dispatch, the suppression policy, all nine format bodies, text-only color/template state and the CLI's ordering, while report/csv and peers degrade to one-line forwards beside a duplicated report.WriteCSV/csv.WriteReport API. The healthy boundary is this repo's actual upstream state, making the ownership lie and change amplification unmistakable.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Every output change — a CSV column, a color, a filter rule, a template — lands in one interconnected method family, so unrelated format tweaks collide and review needs the whole pipeline; the facade packages and doubled exported API (report.WriteCSV beside csv.WriteReport) must stay synchronized. Removing this restores real per-format ownership and honest navigation, though only within the presentation subsystem, not architecture-wide.

development_plausibility.evidence: Bodies are verbatim moves of the repo's own production code with unchanged doc comments, license headers, go.mod-backed imports and byte-identical templates; the shims and CLI delegates read as genuine importer-compatibility caution. But one sweeping change consolidated nine formats, assets, ordering and dispatch at once, and the tidy renderer core/data/templates/reports cluster reads as designed for the task rather than accreted evolution.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: Every factual claim verifies against code: six named CLI flags, nine formats, json/sarif suppression exemptions, text fallback for unknown formats, per-package signatures. The contract materially blocks costly failure: exact exported-signature preservation protects library importers; the byte-identical requirement covers suppression filtering that existing tests assert only as non-empty output; the junit/sonar/sarif fences and unmodifiable test expectations block redesign and test-loosening.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Five-plus purposes demand different code-supported decisions: plain serializers copy back (csv must keep flush-time error reporting, pinned by a failing-writer test); template formats must move embedded assets and demote receiver color state; junit/sonar are cut at GenerateReport; sarif needs no relocation; the policy needs a pre-render home preserving exemptions and shared-slice mutation; ordering needs one owner matching the pinned comparator.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt enumerates the packages, but classifying locations combines components: suppression placement reconciles dispatch-path semantics with per-format direct-call tests that run csv.WriteReport unfiltered; ordering pairs the CLI's flagged call site with report's absorbed helpers; junit/sonar builders and report/sarif (whose body never moved) must be excluded from uniform repair. Dispatch is a plain switch — no alias or registration indirection.

repair_coordination.evidence: Interlocking rules: moving a body forces simultaneous dispatch, shim and parallel-wrapper edits; template code drags its go:embed asset or the build breaks; where the suppression policy lands dictates each relocated body's contents and how the CLI's two sequential writes on one shared ReportInfo behave; ordering's owner dictates the CLI delegates. Editing only one side leaves duplicated paths, dead wrappers or divergent filtering.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: One uniform relocate-and-repoint rule cleanly fixes only the four plain serializers (json, yaml, csv, golint) — under 40% of roughly thirteen absorbed responsibilities. Template formats need asset and package-state decisions, junit/sonar a boundary cut at GenerateReport, sarif no move at all, and the policy, ordering, wrapper cleanup and renderer core each need separate decisions before uniform coverage nears a majority.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Two unchecked paths exist: formatter_test.go asserts suppression filtering for csv/yaml/junit/html/sonar/golint only as non-empty output, and colored mode only as non-empty. Relocating or non-mutating the filter passes every single render yet diverges when the CLI prints then saves one shared ReportInfo (main.go:617-626); each stage alone is correct, and no existing test renders twice, so the combination escapes unnoticed.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
